distinguishing_fact: Model 225B is composed of brass (61% copper, 35% zinc, 4% other material) without precious metal plating or coating, whereas 7419.80.30 requires the copper article to be coated or plated with precious metal.
reasoning: Model 225B is a brass snap hook composed of 61% copper, 35% zinc, and 4% other material. Under Note 5 to Section XV, an alloy of base metals is classified as an alloy of the metal which predominates by weight over each of the other metals; thus, it is treated as a copper alloy under Note 1(b) to Chapter 74. Heading 8308 is excluded per EN 83.08 and HQ 954696 because snap hooks with spring catches and swivels possess mechanical fastening functionality beyond simple hooks. Explanatory Notes to heading 74.19 cover copper articles corresponding to heading 73.26 (which explicitly includes snap hooks). Following the 2022 HTS revision replacing 7419.99 with 7419.80, the article is not wire cloth, springs, chain, or coated/plated with precious metal, classifying under 8-digit subheading 7419.80.50.

distinguishing_fact: Subheading 3822.90 covers certified reference materials accompanied by a certificate indicating certified property values and measurement uncertainty pursuant to Note 2(a) to Chapter 38, whereas the merchandise consists of disposable diagnostic reagents on a backing for blood glucose testing classified under 3822.19.00.
reasoning: The merchandise consists of CareSens N and other blood glucose test strips. These items are composed of layers containing chemical reagent mixtures on a backing designed to measure glucose concentration in whole blood via an electrochemical reaction in conjunction with a blood glucose meter. By application of GRI 1, the goods fall under heading 3822 as diagnostic reagents on a backing. Within heading 3822, subheadings 3822.11 through 3822.13 cover diagnostic reagents for malaria, Zika/Aedes-borne diseases, and blood grouping, none of which apply. Subheading 3822.90 covers certified reference materials under Note 2(a) to Chapter 38. Therefore, the goods fall under subheading 3822.19.00 (and statistical reporting number 3822.19.0080 because the reagent does not contain antigens, antisera, methyl chloroform, or carbon tetrachloride).

For the purposes of heading 3822, the expression "certified reference materials" means reference materials which are accompanied by a certificate which indicates the values of the certified properties, the methods used to determine these values and the degree of certainty associated with each value and which are suitable for analytical, calibrating or referencing purposes.

distinguishing_fact: Subheading 4202.92.15 covers travel/sports bags of vegetable fibers (including cotton) not of pile or tufted construction, whereas 4202.92.33 covers cotton travel/sports bags that are of pile or tufted construction.
reasoning: The merchandise is a backpack constructed with an outer surface of cotton textile material, not of pile or tufted construction, measuring 14 by 11 inches. Heading 4202 covers backpacks and travel bags. Additional U.S. Note 1 to Chapter 42 expressly provides that the expression 'travel, sports and similar bags' includes backpacks of heading 4202. Within subheading 4202.92 for articles with outer surface of textile materials, travel/sports bags with an outer surface of vegetable fibers not of pile or tufted construction of cotton are specifically provided for under 8-digit subheading 4202.92.15 (10-digit 4202.92.1500).

The applicable subheading for the duffle bag will be 4202.92.1500, Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (HTS), which provides for travel, sports and similar bags, with outer surface of textile materials, of vegetable fibers and not of pile or tufted construction, of cotton.

distinguishing_fact: The garment is described as a fully lined sleeveless jacket without insulating padding or batting, excluding it from the specific provision for padded sleeveless jackets under 6201.40.60.
reasoning: The submitted article is a men's hip-length, sleeveless jacket constructed of woven (91% polyester, 9% spandex) and knit components. Under GRI 3(b), the woven component imparts the essential character. Under Note 1 to Chapter 62 and GRI 1, it is classifiable in Chapter 62 under heading 6201 as a men's outerwear jacket/windbreaker-type garment rather than the residual heading 6211. Within heading 6201, it falls under subheading 6201.40 for articles of man-made fibers. Within 6201.40, hip-length jacket-style garments are categorized under anoraks, windbreakers, and similar articles rather than overcoats/carcoats. Because the garment lacks down filling, wool content, padding/batting, water resistance certification, or recreational performance outerwear specifications, it classifies under the residual 8-digit subheading 6201.40.75 (specifically 6201.40.75.11 for Men's).

distinguishing_fact: Additional U.S. Note 1 to Chapter 42 limits travel, sports and similar bags (4202.92.31) to goods designed for carrying clothing and personal effects during travel; the subject bag is specifically designed for holding and transporting tools and accessories.
reasoning: The Kobalt 14-in Rolling Tool Bag is an eo nomine container of heading 4202 constructed of 100% polyester (man-made textile material). Within subheading 4202.92, it is excluded from travel, sports and similar bags under Additional U.S. Note 1 to Chapter 42 because it is designed for carrying tools rather than personal effects or clothing during travel. Under the residual 'Other' provision, because its outer surface is composed of uncoated man-made textile fibers (polyester), it falls under tariff subheading 4202.92.9100.

distinguishing_fact: Subheading 8903.21.00 covers sailboats of a length not exceeding 7.5 meters (~24.6 ft), whereas the subject vessel measures approximately 30 feet (~9.14 meters), exceeding 7.5 m but not exceeding 24 m.
reasoning: The merchandise is a Hinterhoeller Nonsuch 30 Ultra recreational fiberglass sailboat measuring 30 feet in length and equipped with a Westerbeke W27 auxiliary diesel engine. In the post-2022 nomenclature, non-inflatable sailboats under heading 8903 are classified at the 6- and 8-digit level based on vessel length. Subheading 8903.21.00 covers lengths not exceeding 7.5 m, 8903.22.00 covers lengths exceeding 7.5 m but not exceeding 24 m, and 8903.23.00 covers lengths exceeding 24 m. At 30 feet (9.144 meters), the vessel exceeds 7.5 meters and does not exceed 24 meters, classifying it under 8903.22.00.
